STUDENT EXPLANATION CHECK-INS FOR TEACHERS

Collect student reasoning

For teachers who need a low-stakes check-in, students explain one choice by text or voice.

Try it with sample data
Open a populated teacher review; nothing is saved.
Read the three steps
No accounts
Voice deletes on your schedule
Free check-ins accept 35 responses

WHAT A TEACHER RECEIVES

How the check-in works

Review a student’s explanation, confidence, and optional voice note. Use them to plan a follow-up conversation.

01
Create one check-in

Ask one question about a choice or step.

02
Students explain their reasoning

Students can complete the form using only a keyboard.

03
Review each explanation

Save tags and notes for your next conversation.

What this tool does not do

It does not grade, detect AI use, proctor, or verify identity.

Privacy limits

Voice deletes on the selected schedule. Keep private review links secure.

Student explanation check-ins for teachers.
No automated grading or identity checks.
